profile_text.body:
Rev is a for-profit company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Austin, TX. The company describes itself as an investigative intelligence and legal transcription platform built for investigations that need to hold up in court. Its site presents a legal AI platform that turns digital evidence into verified, citable findings, and it offers tools including multi-file evidence analysis, an AI image analyzer, AI templates for tasks such as incident timelines, evidentiary discrepancy reviews, and oral argument preparation, as well as a transcript editor, document editor, and mobile app. The company states it is trusted by bar associations and legal organizations across the country and describes itself as the State Bar of Texas's first official legal AI partner.

Rev's core tracked product is Rev AI, a voice and audio offering that combines a speech-to-text API with transcription, captioning, and a human-plus-AI hybrid model, with an emphasis on data confidentiality. The site also highlights transparent, on-demand cost estimation for human and AI transcripts, captions, and subtitles, and a library of ready-made AI templates that users can apply directly to case evidence without manual data entry. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company in the site's current facts.
